## Contributing Guidelines

Thank you for your interest in contributing to our supplementary repository! 

At this time, we are not accepting changes to the existing version, as it enables full reproduction of our work. Our repository aligns with the [FAIR principles](https://www.nature.com/articles/sdata201618) (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable), which aim to maximize the usability and long-term value of data and resources.

### Contribution Scope

We are only able to accept contributions if:
- You encounter issues running the simulations
- You identify additional files necessary to enhance the completeness of the project.

If you find an issue or have a suggestion within this scope, please open an issue using [GitHub’s dedicated procedure](https://docs.github.com/en/issues/tracking-your-work-with-issues/using-issues/creating-an-issue).

Thank you for helping us maintain and improve the quality of our work!
